newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH GANT CURRENCY EXCHANGER EYES H1 FLOTATION.
newsitem.headline: POLISH GANT CURRENCY EXCHANGER EYES H1 FLOTATION.

text.p: Polish private money exchanger Gant SA plans a public offering for the first half of next year and to enter the parallel market of the Warsaw bourse by June, the firm's largest shareholder said on Monday.

"We've already submitted an issue prospectus to the Securities Commission (KPW), so the public offering could be in three or four months and a listing in June," Grzegorz Antkowiak, who holds 33 percent of Gant, told Reuters.
Antkowiak said the firm, which currently has 2.4 million shares, would issue 1.2 million to 1.3 million new shares at between eight and 14 zlotys each.
He said none of the firm's 59 other shareholders held more than 10 percent of the firm's shares.
Antkowiak said proceeds from the issue would help boost money changing operations, though some could go to expanding the firm's network of outlets.
He said the firm netted 100,000 zlotys last year on about 150 million zlotys in turnover and expected to net 700,000 zlotys this year on 300 million zlotys in turnover.
He said the firm earned 400,000 million zlotys during this year's first 11 months on a 250 million zloty turnover.
